annotation.title_clean: Robot, let us pray! Can and should robots have religious functions? An ethical exploration of religious robots
annotation.title_en: Robot, let us pray! Can and should robots have religious functions? An ethical exploration of religious robots
annotation.summary_en: Philosophical and religious-studies article exploring whether robots can and should perform religious functions such as blessing, prayer accompaniment and ceremonies. It reviews existing religious robots (BlessU-2, SanTO), weighs arguments and objections, identifies ethical challenges, and proposes brief criteria for developing and deploying religious robots.
key_provisions_or_claims: Religious robots are absent from robot ethics discourse and raise new ethical questions.
About 20 religious robots exist worldwide, e.g., BlessU-2 and SanTO.
Approach defines religious robots by religious practices rather than technical properties.
Interreligious perspective with Christian focus, combining philosophy and theology.
Proposes brief criteria for development and deployment of religious robots.
